# API reference

Every operation of the haau3 platform API (`1.0.0-preview.12`) is a method on `*haau3.Client`, named by
its operationId in Go's style (`fhirMetadata` is `FHIRMetadata`). Each links to its page on
docs.haau3.com, which shows its parameters and an example exchange. Every method takes a
`context.Context` first; then the path values; then `body` for an operation that takes one;
then its query parameters as a struct, `<Method>Params`, whose fields are the API's own names in
Go's style (`name:contains` is `NameContains`, `_count` is `Count`), each documented with both.
Every method also takes the per-call options `WithTimeout`, `WithMaxRetries`, `WithCorrelationID`,
`WithHeader`, `WithAPIKey` and `WithResponseInfo`, which gives the request id and timing too.

`Client.Batch` sends several of these as one request, each with its own answer or error, from the
entries `haau3.Calls` makes. It takes every operation on the FHIR base except `FHIRBatch`, `ProcessMessage` and `ReconcileMedications`:
29 of the 37. See the README's "Several requests in one".

## FHIR base

What the FHIR R4 base at `/v1/fhir/r4` answers for every service on it: the `CapabilityStatement` that lists them all, and batch Bundles that carry several requests to any of them in one round trip.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`FHIRBatch(ctx, body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/fhir-base/run-several-operations-in-one-request-batch) | `POST /v1/fhir/r4` | Run several operations in one request (batch) |
| [`FHIRMetadata(ctx, params)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/fhir-base/capability-statement) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/metadata` | Capability statement |

## Questionnaires

FHIR Questionnaire, served as its source publishes it. This service holds copies of a curated set and reaches any other questionnaire its source publishes by canonical URL, as well as forms published at their own address under places this service is set up to reach. Read one by id, and build the QuestionnaireResponse in your own application.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`SearchQuestionnaire(ctx, params)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/questionnaires/list-or-find-a-questionnaire) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/Questionnaire` | List or find a questionnaire |
| [`ReadQuestionnaire(ctx, id)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/questionnaires/read-a-questionnaire) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/Questionnaire/{id}` | Read a questionnaire |

## Medical Benefits

FHIR InsurancePlan: what a Medicare Advantage or ACA Marketplace plan covers and what a member pays, read from the files CMS publishes. Every plan names the CMS release it was read from. Read a plan by its id, or search by identifier, name, state or county, and check whether the CMS National Provider Directory lists providers in a plan's network.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`SearchInsurancePlan(ctx, params)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/find-a-plan) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan` | Find a plan |
| [`ListInsurancePlanCounties(ctx, params)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/list-a-states-counties) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan/$counties` | List a state's counties |
| [`ReadInsurancePlan(ctx, id)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/read-a-plan) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan/{id}` | Read a plan |
| [`CheckInsurancePlanNetwork(ctx, id, params)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/check-providers-against-a-plans-network) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan/{id}/$in-network` | Check providers against a plan's network |

## Pharmacy Benefits

The CARIN Consumer Real-Time Pharmacy Benefit Check as FHIR messaging: what a medication would cost a member under their coverage, or its price at pharmacies near a ZIP code, in real time, from the sources this service connects to. A member's request receives patient data, so send it only under an executed agreement.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`ProcessMessage(ctx, body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/pharmacy-benefits/check-what-a-medication-costs-pharmacy-benefit-check) | `POST /v1/fhir/r4/$process-message` | Check what a medication costs (pharmacy benefit check) |

## MedList

One reconciled medication list from one patient's FHIR medication records, as US Core MedicationRequests with a Provenance for each. This operation receives patient data, so send it only under an executed agreement.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`ReconcileMedications(ctx, body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medlist/reconcile-one-patients-medication-records) | `POST /v1/fhir/r4/$reconcile-medications` | Reconcile one patient's medication records |
